conclusion.rule: Every selected operating-point confirmation passes; all failed higher-rate attempts retained; candidate minimum >=1.1 times best passing seqs=1 and exceeds observed throughput ranges

configuration.arrivals: deterministic open-loop; no client concurrency cap

hardware.memory_reporting: GB10 unified memory; dedicated nvidia-smi memory.total/free unavailable, host MemAvailable recorded instead

evidence_scope: Public aggregates and benchmark methodology only. Raw per-request records, telemetry, deployment configuration, workload and scripts are retained in the local experiment artifacts.
